task: GAP-01 slice 3 — why BENCH-02 declares a successor frozen-instance manifest
question: BENCH-01 recorded 45 `hash_mismatch` rows: nine present `data/cases` models whose sha256 disagreed with the 2026-09-28 freeze, so they stayed in the denominator and never executed. A recorded row is never rewritten, so the only way to run them is a new preregistration over a successor manifest (benchmark campaign contract section 3: "evidence/frozen-instances-20260928.json or its successor"). This record documents the drift, what can and cannot be proven about it, and the comparability of the two campaigns.

drift_audit.method: re-hash every declared instance of evidence/frozen-instances-20260928.json from the working tree with sha256

successor.fields_changed_vs_predecessor: only date/frozen_at, the successor_of and changed_vs_predecessor records, and the sha256 of the nine files; suites, ids, names, families, problem classes, splits, presence flags, counts, timing and curated blocks are copied field-for-field, so the declared subset is identical (verified: 265 ids in the same order, present flags all equal)

seven_of_nine_comment_equivalent.claim: for seven of the nine files the 2026-09-28 frozen bytes are exactly the pre-comment commit blob, the commit that changed them added only `*` comment lines, and comment-stripped bytes at that commit equal comment-stripped bytes at HEAD — so frozen and current content differ only by MPS comment lines
evidence: `git show a9c7e42^:<id>` sha256 equals the frozen sha256 for all seven
commit a9c7e42 (2026-09-29 11:11 +0530) adds 2-5 `*` lines per file and nothing else: `git diff a9c7e42^ a9c7e42 -- data/cases/` shows only `+* ...` additions
sha256 of bytes with `^\s*\*` lines removed is equal between a9c7e42 and HEAD for all nine files

what_is_proven.same_subset: the successor re-declares the identical 265 cells with identical splits, classes and presence flags; only nine sha256 values move
what_is_proven.references_unchanged: none of the nine carries a `reference_objective` in its provenance file, and the two preregistrations bind the identical 27-entry `reference_objectives` map (same values, same sources)

binary.determinism_note: byte-identical to the independently configured GAP-01 validation build of the same source state

unrecoverable_frozen_bytes.fact: the sha256 recorded by the 2026-09-28 freeze for these two files is not the sha256 of any committed version of the file (checked every blob in `git log -- <path>`), is not present in the object database (`git cat-file -e` fails), and is not matched by normalizing the committed bytes to CRLF, to no-trailing-newline, to an added trailing newline, or to CR-stripped form
unrecoverable_frozen_bytes.history: both files entered the repository in the 2026-09-28 12:32/12:33 IST "Upload benchmark data batch 29/30" commits and were rewritten by a9c7e42 the next day; the freeze evidently recorded a working-tree state that was never committed and no longer exists in this checkout
unrecoverable_frozen_bytes.consequence: for these two models the equivalence of the 2026-09-28 content with the content BENCH-02 runs CANNOT be demonstrated from this repository. They execute in BENCH-02 as the current committed bytes, exactly as the successor manifest declares them; their BENCH-01 rows remain `hash_mismatch`, their BENCH-02 rows are the only record of their solver behaviour, and no claim is made that the two campaigns measured the same model file for these two cells.
unrecoverable_frozen_bytes.not_claimed: that the models are semantically identical, that the freeze was wrong, or that the BENCH-01 rows for these cells were spurious

bench01.sha256_before_this_campaign: recorded in the bench01 campaign summary

identical_keys: order (same 265 ids in the same order)
preregistration_comparability.metrics_wording: the two preregistrations quote different wording of `solved_fraction` because the original shorthand "rows with status Optimal ÷ declared cells" was corrected before the first campaign completed; the clarification recorded in docs/contracts/benchmark-campaign.md section 6 states the denominator and the computed quantity were always the cell-level one and that the bench01 preregistration is not edited. The quantity bound by both campaigns is the same one.
preregistration_comparability.conclusion: same subset, order, caps, threads, repeats, tolerances and metric quantity; the only intentional differences are the manifest, the pinned solver binary, the campaign id and the timestamp — which is exactly what a new preregistration is for.

not_run_or_not_claimed: BENCH-01's 45 hash_mismatch rows stand; no row was rewritten, re-run or deleted

no speed comparison between the two campaigns: different pinned binaries (BENCH-01's binary predates GAP-01) with worker interference on one host; §12.3 of the contract forbids publishing a ratio across binaries
no second host, no second solver, no significance test
the nine cells carry no reference optimum, so nothing here claims their objectives agree with a known answer
